Review: CloudKeep Business Backup

CloudKeep Business Backup offers automatic daily backups for teams of up to 25 users. Plans start at 4 pounds per user per month, and all data is encrypted before it leaves the device.

In our tests, restoring a 50 GB project folder took just under two hours. The admin console is simple, although reporting options are limited compared with enterprise products.

CloudKeep keeps file versions for 90 days on the standard plan. Customer support is available by email and live chat during UK business hours.

Verdict: a solid, affordable choice for small offices that need reliable backups without complex configuration.
